title: Soda-lime window, not by float glass process
description: Old window made from soda-lime flat glass. Interesting are the distorted reflections of a tree that give an indication that the flat glass was possibly not made by the float glass process.
author: Alexander Fluegel

Soda-lime window, not by float glass process
Old window made from soda-lime flat glass. Interesting are the distorted reflections of a tree that give an indication that the flat glass was possibly not made by the float glass process.
